tests.title: Full function over supply voltage range
procedure: Set ambient 23 °C, window normalized.
Set supply to 9.0 V, then 12 V, then 16.0 V; also 8.9 V and 16.1 V for reference only.
At each voltage perform manual open/close, express open/close, anti-pinch trigger and read WLC_Status.
Record any function not available.

pass_criteria.measure: Function availability (manual, express, anti-pinch, CAN status) at 9.0 V, 12 V and 16.0 V
pass_criteria.limit: full function from 9.0 V to 16.0 V

tests.title: Reduced voltage range: manual only, express disabled
procedure: Window normalized, 23 °C.
Set supply to 8.9 V, 7.5 V and 6.1 V.
At each voltage, make a short press (<300 ms) in open and close directions.
Hold the switch to move the window manually in both directions.
Set supply to 9.1 V and repeat the short press as a reference.

pass_criteria.measure: Express mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V
Manual mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V

tests.title: Motor stop on undervoltage
procedure: Run the motor in manual mode at 12 V.
Step supply from 12 V to 5.9 V and capture supply and motor current with a scope; trigger on the voltage crossing 6.0 V.
Repeat with the step to 5.0 V.
Measure time from crossing 6.0 V to motor current zero.

pass_criteria.measure: Time from supply below 6.0 V to motor stopped

tests.title: Sleep current
procedure: Supply 12 V (13.5 V optional second point), 23 °C.
Put the controller in sleep mode (ignition off, no CAN activity, wait for sleep timeout).
Measure supply current with a calibrated microammeter after settling.
Repeat at -40 °C and 85 °C.

tests.title: Reverse battery withstand
procedure: Connect supply with reversed polarity at -14 V for 60 s, 23 °C.
Restore the correct polarity at 13.5 V.
Run the functional check: movement, CAN, diagnostics, sleep current.

pass_criteria.measure: Controller condition after -14 V for 60 s

tests.title: Manual mode movement and stop on release
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window mid-travel.
Hold the switch in close and in open direction for 1 s; observe window movement.
Release the switch; capture the switch signal and motor drive.
Measure time from release to motor stopped; repeat 10 times in each direction.

pass_criteria.limit: moves while the switch is held

pass_criteria.measure: Time from switch release to window stopped

tests.title: Window movement after ignition off
procedure: Case A: switch ignition off, keep doors closed, press switch at 55 s and at 61 s after ignition off.
Case B: ignition off, open a front door at 20 s, then press the switch just before (19 s) and just after the opening event.
Case C: open a rear door only at 20 s and press the switch.
Record whether the window moves.

pass_criteria.limit: allowed for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first

tests.title: Express mode start by short press
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window mid-travel.
Apply switch presses of 100 ms, 290 ms and 299 ms in close direction, then in open direction.
Apply presses of 301 ms and 350 ms as outside-limit points.
Observe whether the window continues after release.

pass_criteria.measure: Express mode start for press shorter than 300 ms
pass_criteria.limit: starts express mode in the pressed direction

tests.title: Stop express movement with second press
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized.
Start express close; during travel press the switch in close direction again.
Repeat with a press in open direction.
Repeat for express open with both press directions.
Measure time from second press to motor stopped.

pass_criteria.measure: Time from second press to window stopped

tests.title: Full travel time
procedure: Set supply 13.5 V and chamber/ambient 23 °C, normalized.
Start express close from fully open (480 mm).
Measure time to fully closed (0 mm) from CAN position/motor signals.
Repeat 5 times.

pass_criteria.measure: Fully open to fully closed travel time at 13.5 V and 23 °C

tests.title: Motor stop at end positions
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized.
Express close to 0 mm and express open to 480 mm.
Observe the motor current and drive at each end position.

pass_criteria.limit: motor stopped when the window reaches the end position

tests.title: CAN WLC_CloseAll
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window open.
Send CAN WLC_CloseAll from the restbus simulation.
Observe the window closing without the switch.
During closing, place a pinch obstacle in the pinch zone and verify reaction.
Repeat from mid-travel.

pass_criteria.limit: closes the window in express mode

tests.title: Express close only when normalized
procedure: Make the controller not normalized (supply interruption of 600 ms).
Short press in close direction at mid-travel; observe.
Normalize per TC-022 procedure.
Repeat short press close.

tests.title: Pinch detection threshold
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized.
Use force-measuring pinch fixture with calibrated spring rate.
Close in the pinch zone with obstacle at 100 mm; ramp force to 78 N, 80 N and 82 N.
Repeat at 5 mm and 199 mm positions.
Repeat above 200 mm and below 4 mm as outside-zone reference.

pass_criteria.limit: detects a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N

tests.title: Pinch reaction: stop time and reversal distance
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized.
Trigger a pinch at 100 mm; capture motor drive and position.
Measure time from detection to motor stop.
Measure reversal distance.
Trigger a pinch at 4 mm and at 200 mm.
Trigger where less than 150 mm of travel remains to fully open (reduced stroke setup).

pass_criteria.measure: Time from pinch detection to motor stop

pass_criteria.limit: at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.title: Anti-pinch active in manual and express modes
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized.
Close in manual mode and apply pinch obstacle exceeding 80 N in the pinch zone.
Close in express mode and apply the same obstacle.
Observe reaction.

tests.title: Anti-pinch disabled when not normalized
procedure: Interrupt supply for 600 ms to make the controller not normalized.
Close in manual mode and apply an obstacle exceeding 80 N in the pinch zone.
Observe the reaction and WLC_Status normalization state.

tests.title: Express close inhibit after pinch reversal
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized.
Trigger a pinch reversal; mark time t0 when reversal ends.
Attempt express close (short press) at t0+1.9 s and at t0+2.1 s.
Record response each time.

tests.title: Repeated pinch lockout to manual close
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized.
Trigger three pinches within 30 s (e.g. 10 s apart).
Attempt express close, then manual close, immediately and at 59 s and 61 s after the third pinch.
Control case: three pinches spread over more than 30 s, then attempt express close (after 2 s inhibit).

pass_criteria.measure: Closing after three pinch detections within 30 s
pass_criteria.limit: allowed only in manual mode for the next 60 s

tests.title: Position resolution from Hall pulses
procedure: Inject Hall pulse sequences simulating motor travel.
Step the simulated position by single pulses and compare WLC_Status position with a reference.
Check position values across 0 mm to 480 mm.

tests.title: Loss of normalization after supply interruption
procedure: Controller normalized at 13.5 V.
Interrupt supply for 400 ms, 500 ms and 600 ms (and 2 s) in separate runs.
After each, read normalization state in WLC_Status.
Re-normalize between runs.

pass_criteria.measure: Normalization state after supply interruption longer than 500 ms

tests.title: Normalization at closed seal
procedure: Start from not normalized state.
In manual mode hold close with window fully closed against seal for 0.9 s, then release; read state.
Repeat holding for 1.0 s and 1.1 s.
Repeat in express mode attempt (not applicable) and with window not at seal as reference.

pass_criteria.measure: Normalization after window held fully closed against seal in manual mode

tests.title: Thermal model existence
procedure: Review the software design and thermal model documentation.
Verify that motor temperature is estimated with a thermal model and what inputs it uses.
Record the model accuracy requirement, if any.

pass_criteria.measure: Motor temperature estimation by thermal model

tests.title: Thermal current limit and blocking
procedure: Drive the thermal model state via test interface/simulated duty to set the estimated motor temperature.
Set 129 °C, then 131 °C; measure motor current while driving.
Raise to 139 °C, then 141 °C; attempt opening and closing.
Lower the estimate to 121 °C, then 119 °C; attempt opening.

pass_criteria.limit: ends when estimated temperature falls below 120 °C

tests.title: WLC_Status cycle time and content
procedure: Log WLC_Status on CAN for 60 s while idle and while moving.
Compute the period between consecutive messages.
Decode position, movement state, normalization state and fault state; compare to the simulated conditions.

pass_criteria.limit: contains window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state

tests.title: Hall sensor loss DTC B1A01
procedure: Drive the motor and remove the Hall signal for 150 ms, then restore; check DTCs.
Remove Hall signal for 250 ms while driving; check DTC and motor.
Remove Hall signal with motor not driven as a reference.

pass_criteria.measure: DTC B1A01 when Hall signal missing while motor driven
pass_criteria.limit: stored when missing for more than 200 ms

tests.title: Overcurrent DTC B1A02 reactions
procedure: Using the electronic load/blocked motor, apply 24 A for 100 ms, then 26 A for 40 ms, then 26 A for 60 ms.
Read DTCs, motor drive state and WLC_Status fault state after each run.

pass_criteria.limit: stored when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms

pass_criteria.measure: WLC_Status fault state when B1A02 stored

tests.title: Diagnostic response time
procedure: Send 100 diagnostic requests (e.g. read DTC) via the tester.
Measure request-to-response time on the CAN log, also while the window is moving.

tests.title: Operating temperature range
procedure: Place controller with motor load in the chamber; soak at -40 °C, then 85 °C (also 23 °C reference), at least 2 h each.
At each temperature at 13.5 V run manual and express movement, anti-pinch trigger and CAN status check.

tests.title: Wake-up time from sleep
procedure: Put controller in sleep mode at 13.5 V, 23 °C.
Press the switch; capture the switch signal and first motor drive/CAN activity.
Measure time from press to wake; repeat 10 times, also at -40 °C and 85 °C.

pass_criteria.measure: Wake time from sleep after switch press
